method: Same American Stories detector on two horizontal 60% strips with 20% overlap; original class-aware IoU0.10 NMS over translated boxes. Frozen baseline untouched.
observation: Source/overlay inspection shows some beginnings and endings recovered but other half-columns suppressed, leaving much larger omissions. Global NMS suppresses partially overlapping strip detections. More OCR words alone is not an accuracy measure.
conclusion: Naive tiling is not a safe repair. Need tile-aware fusion and full-page text coverage checks before adoption.
review_method: AI visual inspection; not human gold
